_: The task specification (docs/reference/ontology.md). Every field below is read at a point of decision - by run.py, or by the capability run.py hands it to: the containment declaration, the cancel window and its floor, the ceilings this run was admitted under and the tool binding are decided inside the harnesses and come back on the receipt. A field neither would behave differently without would be decoration - and so, in practice, is a field that reaches a record only at the value that breaks the run: test.sh step 1c gives every leaf that was a second legal value and asserts the two records differ. README section 6 names the fields of the four entry documents that are carried and not consumed.
